find their ancestral families, whether Lenni Lenape or Nanticoke. Their
allied ancestral African, Iberian or other European lines will be mentioned
but not further persued, being beyond the scope of this site's research.

Their allied ancestral African, Iberian or other European lines will be mentioned but not further persued, being beyond the scope of this site's research. A cautionary note: Much of the information contained on these pages is hearsay information obtained verbally or by e-mail or letter. Some is copied from official documents.
